eval: (() => { const p = game.player; return { pos: p.position.toArray().map(v => +v.toFixed(2)), onGround: p.onGround, ground: +game.terrain.heightAt(p.position.x, p.position.z).toFixed(2) }; })()
label: spawn

eval: (() => { const r = game.engine.renderer.info; return { calls: r.render.calls, tris: r.render.triangles, geos: r.memory.geometries, tex: r.memory.textures }; })()
label: renderer

eval: (() => { const s = game.atmosphere.sunDir; game.player.yaw = Math.atan2(-s.x, -s.z); game.player.pitch = 0.05; return 'facing sun'; })()
(() => { const s = game.atmosphere.sunDir; game.player.yaw = Math.atan2(s.x, s.z); game.player.pitch = -0.1; return 'away from sun'; })()
